# Real-model test fixtures

- `astronaut.png`: NASA photograph of astronaut Eileen Collins, obtained from scikit-image v0.22.0: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.22.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png . NASA public-domain image; see https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/ for NASA usage and no-endorsement guidance. SHA256: `88431cd9653ccd539741b555fb0a46b61558b301d4110412b5bc28b5e3ea6cb5`.
- `jfk.wav`: eleven-second excerpt of President John F. Kennedy's inaugural address, a US government public-domain speech recording. Obtained from the MIT-licensed whisper.cpp sample collection: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/master/samples/jfk.wav . SHA256: `59dfb9a4acb36fe2a2affc14bacbee2920ff435cb13cc314a08c13f66ba7860e`. The local checksum fixes the otherwise mutable source URL.

These fixtures provide real inference/format evidence, not detection or transcription accuracy benchmarks. US public-domain status may differ in other jurisdictions. No model weights are included.
